focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳数据申报与成本传导双重压力。企业应尽快建立产品级碳排放核算体系，完善供应链数据采集，并关注欧盟认可的核查机构名单。未雨绸缪者可在谈判中争取碳成本抵扣，降低税负冲击。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's CBAM transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive taxation starting in 2027. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers face dual pressures of carbon data reporting and cost pass-through. Companies should establish product-level carbon accounting, enhance supply chain data collection, and monitor EU-accredited verifiers. Early movers can negotiate carbon cost deductions to mitigate the tax burden.

case.title: 新加坡高等法院承认中国法院商事判决，跨境债权执行获关键突破
case.summary: 新加坡高等法院近期依据《选择法院协议公约》承认一起中国法院商事判决，涉及中资企业在新资产执行。该案确立了中国判决在普通法框架下的可执行性先例，强调管辖权审查与程序公正标准。出海企业可在合同中约定新加坡法院管辖并选择适用公约，以增强判决跨境执行力。
case.title_en: Singapore High Court Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment, Breakthrough for Cross-Border Debt Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore High Court recently recognised a Chinese commercial judgment under the Hague Choice of Court Convention, involving enforcement of assets in Singapore held by a Chinese company. The case sets a precedent for enforceability of Chinese judgments under common law, emphasising jurisdictional review and procedural fairness. Outbound enterprises should consider choosing Singapore courts and the Convention to enhance cross-border enforceability.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业需调整合规路径
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期发布跨境数据流动便利化措施，允许特定行业在安全评估后实现数据跨境传输。新规简化了个人信息出境标准合同备案流程，并扩大了“白名单”企业范围。企业应重新评估数据映射，利用大湾区试点政策优化跨境数据传输架构，同时确保符合内地与港澳各自的数据保护要求。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area Require Compliance Adjustments
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area recently issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows, allowing data transfers in specific sectors after security assessments. The new rules streamline the filing process for standard contracts on personal information export and expand the 'whitelist' of enterprises. Companies should reassess data mapping, leverage GBA pilot policies to optimise cross-border data transfer structures, and ensure compliance with data protection requirements in the mainland, Hong Kong, and Macao.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · Nov 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规下，中国企业的风险缓释策略
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部对外投资审查规则进一步收紧，涉及半导体、人工智能、量子技术等领域。中国企业应建立投资前筛查机制，识别受限交易，并善用例外条款与豁免申请。建议在交易文件中加入监管变化条款，预留退出路径，同时通过本地化合作与合规承诺降低审查风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Risk Mitigation Strategies for Chinese Firms under New US Outbound Investment Rules
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury has further tightened outbound investment review rules covering semiconductors, AI, and quantum technologies. Chinese companies should establish pre-investment screening mechanisms to identify restricted transactions and utilise exceptions and exemption applications. It is advisable to include regulatory change clauses in transaction documents, reserve exit paths, and mitigate review risks through local partnerships and compliance commitments.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury · Nov 2026
